motions.item_title: Approve Preliminary Plat for Spring Run Plaza on a 27.35 acre parcel at the northeast corner of…
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve Preliminary Plat for Spring Run Plaza on a 27.35 acre parcel at the northeast corner of Spring Run Parkway and Cory B. Wride Memorial Highway. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
